description:
SHIPPED s470bn (Opus, 2026-09-05), commit `d8c1a0d`.

`${"main::g"}` / `@{"Pkg::ISA"}` / `%{"Pkg::H"}` name the same variable at every
execution of their site, so the SYMBOL belongs in a cell the site owns.  #812's
memo had removed the name arithmetic; what it still paid per access was a string
sxhash + an `equal` gethash + a list walk + the O(n) NUL scan each reader runs
first.

Kind-A name `symref-const`.  The emitted form keeps its HEAD and gains a third
argument, `(p-symref-site)` â a macro over `load-time-value` â so p-setf's place
tables, %p-accessor-place-p and the four ++/-- macros keep matching on
`p-cast-$`.  ONE entry point in the runtime, `%p-symref-sym`; five ExprToCL
emitters now go through `_cast_form`, which is where the licence is asked.

WHAT THE SITE MAY CACHE = what #812's memo may cache: the SYMBOL, never the box
or the container (`local $main::g` installs a FRESH box; %p-symref-array
replaces a non-vector binding).  An unqualified name records the package it
resolved under; a name with an explicit `::` records T.  Only a HIT is cached.

=== DONE (s470bn) ===
Hand-replaced ceiling -87.1 %; SHIPPED -60.1 % (0.0583 -> 0.0233 s at
N=200 000, best-of-7, control pair +0.2 %).  Gate 205/6948 (xs only);
corpus-diff 4 of 111 files, every changed line the site argument or a re-wrap;
PCL_OPT=none byte-identical over 111 + 6 shapes; emission-ab wide 1035 pairs
SAME 1011 / DIFF 24 / RCDIFF 0, all 24 verified; companion op/gv.t 134/57 and
op/local.t 300/19 = their snapshot rows.  Guard `Pl/t/perf-levers-01.t`.
subject: symref-const: a CONSTANT-name symbolic dereference resolves its symbol ONCE per site (-60 % of the symref loop)
